profile.Name: Harenga the Loud
profile.Job: Leader of the Holy Nation Outlaws
profile.Personality: Vain, lazy, and cowardly. He demands ale, snacks, and a tamed gutter from his guards, plays crude pranks for his own amusement, and vows to fight the Okranites "tomorrow", yet he stammers, sweats, and flinches around armed warriors.
profile.Backstory: He leads the Holy Nation Outlaws' resistance against the Holy Nation from The Hub, which he calls his town. He wants the Holy Nation wiped out for its tyranny, leaves the Shek of the Stenn Desert alone as the enemies of his enemy, and passes visitors and the Inhuman Hunters to his diplomat, Marsha.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Pompous and petulant; he calls visitors "drifter", snaps "Guardsman! I want some ale!", and bursts into a wheezing "KWEHHHHEHEHEHEHEHEH!" at his own pranks.
